resources.string: Android only lets apps change the system theme after you grant WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS over ADB. Enable USB debugging, connect your phone, and run this once:
adb shell pm grant com.samhrncir.lightswitch android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS
Come back to this app afterwards; the card disappears once the permission is granted.
